nom: Hero Cosmetics Mighty Patch Face Pore Pimple Patches

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report mixed outcomes: one describes severe redness, burning and tightness requiring the product to be stopped, another says it left red patch-shaped marks days later, while a different reviewer with 'sensitive dry skin' calls it approved and effective.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry skin reports the patches left dry patches on the face, while another with 'sensitive dry skin' reports it as approved and non-drying.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin and an oily T-zone report visibly smaller pores, less oil, and improved texture after overnight use.
segments.oily: One reviewer describes their oily T-zone and enlarged pores improving noticeably, with less visible oil showing through by end of day.

concerns.dehydration: One reviewer reports skin feeling more hydrated and smooth after leaving the patch on overnight; another says the product does not dry out skin and soothes redness; one dissenting reviewer reports the patches left dry patches on the face.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report reduced redness and swelling around the nose and cheeks, but one reviewer reports a severe reaction with extreme redness, burning and tightness after use, and another reports lasting red patch-shaped marks days later.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits the patches with helping after a damaged skin barrier from at-home dermaplaning, reporting improvement; no other barrier-specific reports appear.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers describing individual pimples or spots report them shrinking or disappearing within one to a few days of use, including hormonal breakouts; one reviewer reports no visible improvement and calls the product ineffective for the price.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers with acne, cystic pimples, or clustered breakouts report visible reduction in size and faster healing, including safe use during pregnancy; one reviewer reports the product made her break out worse.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin and oily T-zones report the patches absorbing excess oil and gunk overnight, with smaller-looking pores by morning; no dissent noted on this point specifically.

extraits.titre: Unexpected Skin Reaction After Using This Product
extraits.texte: I wanted to share my experience in case it helps others. After using this product my skin became extremely red, irritated, and painful immediately after removing the patches. I experienced noticeable burning and tightness, especially on my cheeks and around my eyes (see attached photos). I followed the directions exactly and have not had this type of reaction to other skincare products before. I had to stop using it immediately and apply a soothing product to calm my skin. If you have sensitive skin or allergies, I recommend doing a patch test first or consulting a dermatologist before use. I really wish this product had worked for me, but unfortunately, it caused a severe reaction. I hope the company takes feedback like this seriously and reviews the formulation.

Okay, I use the little pimple patches all the time and I love them, however if you have sensitive skin DO NOT USE THIS PRODUCT!!!!
